blocks.text: Optimize your Gmail environment on Mac

Most B2B sales reps rely on a browser for email. You should turn your Gmail into a standalone app experience. In Safari, go to File > Add to Dock. This creates a dedicated icon in your dock. It keeps your inbox separate from your research tabs. In Chrome, use the Create Shortcut feature with the Open as window option checked. This change prevents you from getting lost in dozens of open browser tabs.
Master keyboard shortcuts for faster outreach

Keyboard shortcuts turn email management into a reflex. First, go to Settings > General > Keyboard shortcuts and turn them on. Once active, press the ? key to see the full list. Use c to compose, e to archive, and r to reply. These small habits save minutes every hour. When you need to search for a prospect, just press / and start typing.

B2B sales requires high volume, but you must respect Google limits. Personal accounts are capped at 500 recipients per day. Google Workspace accounts allow up to 2,000 recipients. These limits count total recipients in To, Cc, and Bcc fields. If you exceed these, Google will lock your account for 24 hours. Monitor your sends to keep your pipeline moving.
How to use Lazur for your sales workflow

Lazur lives in your Mac notch and helps you move faster. Hold the fn key to dictate your follow-up emails directly into the body of your message. It handles formatting and punctuation. If you forget where a setting is, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to point it out. Lazur draws a circle on your screen to show you exactly where to click.

items: Not using labels to organize your sales funnel stages.
Leaving too many tabs open which slows down your Mac performance.
Failing to use templates for common outreach sequences.
Ignoring the archive function and letting your inbox clutter.
Sending mass emails without checking your daily recipient count.

blocks.text: Practical tips for better sales communication

Always keep your email signature updated with your current meeting link. Use the scheduling feature to send emails at the exact time your prospect is likely to read them. If you work across time zones, check the local time of your lead before hitting send. Keep your subject lines short and focused on the value you provide.
Why B2B sales reps need a clean Mac setup

You juggle CRM data, LinkedIn prospecting, and email daily. A cluttered desktop kills your flow. Use tools like Maccy for clipboard management to paste lead data into emails quickly. Use SideNotes for quick thoughts during calls. Keep your browser tabs organized by deal or prospect. A clean setup allows you to focus on the 30 percent of your time that generates revenue.

faq.question: Is there an official Gmail app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, Google does not provide a native desktop app for macOS. You should use a browser-based web app for the best experience.

faq.question: How do I enable keyboard shortcuts in Gmail?
faq.answer: Go to Settings in Gmail, select the General tab, and find the Keyboard shortcuts section. Click the radio button to turn them on.

faq.question: What happens if I send too many emails?
faq.answer: If you exceed your daily recipient limit, Google will block your account from sending emails for 24 hours.

faq.question: Does Lazur work inside Gmail?
faq.answer: Yes, Lazur works in any app on your Mac. You can use it to dictate text or find UI elements while you have Gmail open in your browser.
